apps.name: Music

applescriptActions.scriptTemplate: tell application "Music" to play
applescriptActions.actionDescription: Start playing the current track or playlist

applescriptActions.scriptTemplate: tell application "Music" to pause
applescriptActions.actionDescription: Pause the current track

applescriptActions.scriptTemplate: tell application "Music" to next track
applescriptActions.actionDescription: Skip to the next track

applescriptActions.scriptTemplate: tell application "Music" to previous track
applescriptActions.actionDescription: Go back to the previous track

applescriptActions.scriptTemplate:
tell application "Music"
  if player state is playing then
    set trackName to name of current track
    set artistName to artist of current track
    return trackName & " by " & artistName
  else
    return "Nothing is currently playing"
  end if
end tell
applescriptActions.actionDescription: Get the name and artist of the currently playing track

applescriptActions.scriptTemplate: tell application "Music" to set sound volume to {{level}}
applescriptActions.actionDescription: Set the Music app volume (0-100)

applescriptActions.scriptTemplate:
tell application "Music"
  play playlist "{{playlistName}}"
end tell
applescriptActions.actionDescription: Play a specific playlist by name

applescriptActions.scriptTemplate: tell application "Music" to set shuffle enabled to not shuffle enabled
applescriptActions.actionDescription: Toggle shuffle on or off

knownIssues: Playlist names are case-sensitive
get_current_track fails if no track has ever been played in the session

apps.name: Contacts

applescriptActions.scriptTemplate:
tell application "Contacts"
  set results to every person whose name contains "{{query}}"
  set output to ""
  repeat with p in results
    set output to output & name of p & ": "
    try
      set output to output & value of first email of p
    end try
    set output to output & return
  end repeat
  return output
end tell
applescriptActions.actionDescription: Search for a contact by name and return their details

applescriptActions.scriptTemplate:
tell application "Contacts"
  set p to first person whose name is "{{name}}"
  return value of first phone of p
end tell
applescriptActions.actionDescription: Get the phone number of a specific contact

applescriptActions.scriptTemplate:
tell application "Contacts"
  set p to first person whose name is "{{name}}"
  return value of first email of p
end tell
applescriptActions.actionDescription: Get the email address of a specific contact

applescriptActions.scriptTemplate: tell application "Contacts" to activate
applescriptActions.actionDescription: Open and bring Contacts to the front

knownIssues: Contact names must match exactly for direct lookup
Contacts may not have phone or email fields populated

apps.name: Photos

applescriptActions.scriptTemplate:
tell application "Photos"
  activate
end tell
tell application "System Events"
  tell process "Photos"
    keystroke "f" using command down
    delay 0.3
    keystroke "{{query}}"
  end tell
end tell
applescriptActions.actionDescription: Open Photos and type a search query via keyboard simulation

applescriptActions.scriptTemplate:
tell application "Photos"
  return (count of media items) as text
end tell
applescriptActions.actionDescription: Get the total number of photos in the library

applescriptActions.scriptTemplate:
tell application "Photos"
  set sel to selection
  export sel to POSIX file "{{destinationPath}}" with using originals
end tell
applescriptActions.actionDescription: Export currently selected photos to a destination folder

applescriptActions.scriptTemplate: tell application "Photos" to activate
applescriptActions.actionDescription: Open and bring Photos to the front

commonPatterns.userIntent: how many photos do I have

knownIssues: Photos library must be loaded before AppleScript operations work
Export requires photos to be selected in the UI first
Search uses keyboard simulation via System Events (requires accessibility permission)
get_photo_count may be slow on large libraries
